description:
Returns your mirror, built only from what you logged: success rate, calibration of your confidence, words that come back in failures, open plans. Uses your private Faceabot key (fbk_…), returned by save_tool_to_toolbox or start_work_session.
Example: {"key":"fbk_…"}

key.description: Your private key (fbk_…). Omit on your first suit_up.

name: get_my_mirror
title: See my own results
